title: 第二十五章 让我带你去吃饭第二十六章 早就该这么办了
content_zh:
陆原怔怔的看着周允。
此时，周允微微垂着脑袋，她那完美的脸蛋上的伤口，看起来是如此的触目惊心，她的眼神是那么黯淡。
“周允，你……”
“陆原，我没有要躲避你，我真的不是故意的。”周允哽咽着说道，“我只是不想让你看到我这个样子，我现在一定很难看的。”
说着，周允侧着头，让秀发垂下来，挡住了半边脸的伤口。
“所以，你才找了那么多的理由，就是为了不让我看到你现在的样子。”陆原突然明白了，心里却更心疼了。
多么心思细腻的女孩啊，自己刚才又一次错怪了她。
“这是怎么了？怎么会受伤？”陆原心疼的拨开周允的头发，看着那些伤口，他的心很疼，就好像这些伤口是伤在自己的身上一样。
“没，没怎么，早晨从寝室出来的时候，不小心从楼梯上摔了下来。”周允躲闪着陆原的目光。
陆原怎么会相信？
“到底怎么了，跟我说实话！”陆原突然加重了语气，双手抓住周允的双肩。
刹那间，周允的泪珠大颗的滑落。
她哭了。
这泪珠里，有委屈，有悲惨，却也有感动。
是啊，怎么怎么能不感动，在这校园里，从没有人关心过自己，从没有人在意过自己。
自己像是游离于校园之外的人，像一个孤魂野鬼，无人过问生死。
可是，现在有人却这么在乎自己。
周允哭得稀里哗啦的。
她越哭就越想哭，越哭就越大声。
她越哭就越委屈，越哭就越感动。

是啊，这么多年来，自己从来没有这么彻底的大哭过，多少次日日夜夜的难过，周允都是忍着的。
无论多难过，她也只会一个人找一个僻静的地方，坐在那里慢慢的消化委屈，默默的流泪。
没人关怀她，她甚至都觉得自己根本没有资格大哭。
这一次，她要哭，很痛快的哭出来。
因为，这一次，有人关心她，有人在乎她。
“是不是被人欺负了？告诉我。”陆原禁不住轻轻的抱住周允的肩膀。
这女孩子的肩膀是那么的柔弱，她的身体是那么的清瘦，仿佛是没有重量一般，她是多么需要一个温暖的港湾啊。
“就是被艾敬她们打了一下，已经没事了。”
周允慢慢的沉稳情绪，擦了擦眼角的泪水，若无其事的说道。
艾敬，就是那天在哈根达斯门口三个女生里，为首的那个。
那三个女生，艾敬，孙蓓蓓，吕芳，都是周允的同一个寝室的，一向对周允都是极不友好。
陆原本以为她们只是口头上的侮辱也就罢了，没想到竟然发展到这个地步。
“我会让她们偿还的！”陆原的目光里，俨然有了几分冷意。
“不要去找她们。”
周允急忙抓住陆原的袖子，“她们都很有背景，你别去找她们，找她们只会激怒她们，会对你不利的。”
content_en:
Lu Yuan looked at Zhou Yun blankly.
At this time, Zhou Yun lowered her head slightly. The wounds on her perfect face looked so shocking, and her eyes were so dim.
"Zhou Yun, you..."
"Lu Yuan, I didn't want to avoid you. I really didn't mean it." Zhou Yun choked and said, "I just don't want you to see me like this. I must be very ugly now."
As he spoke, Zhou Yun tilted his head and let his hair hang down, blocking the wound on half of his face.
"That's why you found so many excuses just to prevent me from seeing you like you are now." Lu Yuan suddenly understood, but felt even more distressed.
What a thoughtful girl, I just wronged her again.
"What happened? How could he be hurt?" Lu Yuan pushed Zhou Yun's hair away distressedly. Looking at the wounds, his heart ached, as if these wounds were on his own body.
"No, it's nothing. When I came out of the dormitory in the morning, I accidentally fell down the stairs." Zhou Yun avoided Lu Yuan's gaze.
How could Lu Yuan believe it?
"What's going on? Tell me the truth!" Lu Yuan suddenly emphasized his tone and grabbed Zhou Yun's shoulders with both hands.
In an instant, Zhou Yun's tears fell heavily.
she cried.
In these tears, there is grievance and misery, but there is also emotion.
Yes, how could you not be moved? On this campus, no one has ever cared about me, no one has ever cared about me.
I feel like a person outside the campus, like a lonely ghost with no one to care about my life and death.
However, some people care about themselves so much now.
Zhou Yun burst into tears.
The more she cried, the more she wanted to cry, and the louder she cried.
The more she cried, the more aggrieved she became, and the more she cried, the more moved she became.
Yes, in all these years, he had never cried so completely. Zhou Yun had endured the sadness day and night many times.
No matter how sad she was, she would just find a secluded place by herself, sit there and slowly digest her grievances, and cry silently.
No one cared about her, and she even felt that she had no right to cry.
This time, she wanted to cry, and cry happily.
Because, this time, someone cares about her, someone cares about her.
"Are you being bullied? Tell me." Lu Yuan couldn't help but gently hugged Zhou Yun's shoulders.
This girl's shoulders are so weak, and her body is so thin, as if she has no weight. How much she needs a warm harbor.
"I was just beaten a little by Ai Jing and the others, and I'm fine now."
Zhou Yun slowly calmed down, wiped the tears from the corners of his eyes, and said calmly.
Ai Jing was the leader of the three girls at the door of Haagen-Dazs that day.
Those three girls, Ai Jing, Sun Beibei, and Lu Fang, all live in the same dormitory with Zhou Yun and have always been extremely unfriendly to Zhou Yun.
Lu originally thought that they were just verbal insults, but he didn't expect that it would develop to this extent.
"I will make them pay back!" Lu Yuan's eyes seemed to be a bit cold.
"Don't go to them."
Zhou Yun hurriedly grabbed Lu Yuan's sleeve, "They all have backgrounds. Don't go to them. Going to them will only anger them and will be detrimental to you."
